row.reason: Both are diversified engineered-component manufacturers. Crane makes valves, pumps and flow-control equipment for chemical, energy and water customers. It also makes aerospace and defense components. ITT's Flow Technologies segment makes pumps and valves for energy, chemical and industrial customers, and its Aerospace Controls brand makes actuators and fluid control devices for aerospace and defense. Both sell products to OEMs and industrial users and add aftermarket sales. ITT also has automotive and rail friction and shock-absorber lines. Crane has no matching line, but the overlap covers both of Crane's material businesses.

T:P1.1.text: Innovation Driven by Engineering Excellence | Crane Co.

T:P1.2.text: Crane Co. delivers engineered solutions for aerospace, defense, flow technologies, and critical industries—driven by innovation and 170 years of excellence.

T:P1.4.text: Our businesses are driven by proprietary and differentiated technology, proven reliability, deep vertical expertise, and responsiveness to unique customer needs.

T:P1.5.text: Redefining What’s Possible in Mission-Critical Innovation.

T:P1.6.text: We push the boundaries of innovation, delivering proprietary solutions that set new standards for mission-critical performance across aerospace, defense, and other demanding environments.

T:P1.7.text: Engineering Excellence Built for Mission-Critical Challenges.

T:P1.8.text: We deliver highly engineered, proprietary solutions that ensure reliability in mission-critical applications across the harshest environments—from cryogenics and nuclear to pharmaceutical, chemical, and water.

T:P1.10.text: Crane has always been an engineering led company. As our organization continues to mature, we are continuing to refine our approach to innovation and new product development.

T:P1.11.text: “I am resolved to conduct my business in the strictest honesty and fairness; to avoid all deception and trickery; to deal fairly with both customers and competitors; to be liberal and just toward employees; and to put my whole mind upon the business.”

T:P1.12.text: Richard Teller Crane, Founder of Crane Co.

T:P1.13.text: Our strategy is built for durability, innovation, and long-term success.

T:P1.14.text: We believe that attracting and retaining the highest quality people is the best insurance of success.

T:P2.1.text: Crane Co. Process Flow Technologies | Valves, Pumps & Controls

T:P2.2.text: Crane Co. delivers process flow technologies for chemical, energy, water, nuclear, and industrial markets, including valves, pumps, instrumentation, and controls.

T:P2.3.text: Crane’s Process Flow Technologies segment is a global provider of highly engineered products and systems, including sensing, instrumentation, controls, and flow control products. With more than 170 years of engineering excellence and expertise, Crane literally wrote the book on flow control with the introduction of the Flow of Fluids Handbook (TP410) that is still used as a definitive source in the industry.

T:P2.4.text: Today, with proprietary technology, precision engineering, and material science innovation, we are solving our customers’ toughest challenges in mission-critical applications that require high-reliability in many of the harshest and most hazardous environments such as cryogenics, nuclear, pharmaceutical, chemical and petrochemical, and wastewater.

T:P2.5.text: Crane ChemPharma & Energy designs and manufactures a variety of high-performance products for the regulation and control of fluids and gases. Its trusted brands offer customers a complete and innovative product portfolio designed for the most demanding corrosive, erosive, and high purity applications.

T:P2.6.text: Primary industries served include cryogenics, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, chemical and petrochemical processing, and power generation. As an integrated fluid handling solutions provider, Crane ChemPharma & Energy is well equipped to respond to complex global projects with comprehensive product packages and timely proposals to simplify our customers’ supply chain on a local level worldwide.

C:P1.2.text: ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and energy markets.

C:P1.3.text: ITT's highly engineered critical components keep the world safe, moving and sustainable

C:P1.4.text: We're engineers and innovators who solve our customers' most critical challenges

C:P1.5.text: At ITT, we make a lasting difference in the world by powering key industries, advancing transportation safety and comfort, connecting people to data and each other, and securing essential infrastructure

C:P1.6.text: Our global brands keep the world moving

C:P1.7.text: With more than 175 years of history, ITT Goulds Pumps is among the most widely recognized and respected brands in the global pump industry, serving leading customers in the energy, chemical and general industrial markets

C:P1.8.text: We serve growing end markets including automotive, rail, chemical, industrial, aerospace and defense, among others

C:P1.9.text: To see the various applications of highly engineered ITT products, watch the video to the left

C:P1.10.text: Our solutions change the modern world

C:P2.2.text: We are a manufacturer of critical, engineered components that serve fast-growing end markets in transportation, flow, energy, aerospace and defense.

C:P2.3.text: We are committed every day to reflecting our core principles. These principles not only enhance our ability to achieve our purpose, they also define our high-performing culture and help us deliver on our ambitious growth strategy.

C:P2.4.text: Around the world, we have a clear vision of where key industries are headed and how we can help customers reach their goals by thinking our way around obstacles, creating solutions and finding answers to complex technical and engineering challenges. Our customers rely on our expertise to create better products to serve their customers and at the same time increase uptime and energy efficiency in their manufacturing operations.

C:P2.5.text: We produce our wide range of innovative products and solutions through three operating segments: Flow Technologies, Motion Technologies, and Connect and Control Technologies.

C:P2.6.text: We strive to make our work environment inclusive and welcoming. By encouraging a healthy, high-performing culture and by making our customers central to everything we do, we create an atmosphere that enhances innovation and the success of our talented employees. Together, our purpose and principles guide our words and actions every day and are truly touchstones that unite employees across ITT as we aim to develop solutions to complex challenges and make a positive and enduring impact.

C:P3.2.text: With over 90 years of aerospace technology development, Aerospace Controls is leading the way in design, engineering and manufacturing of top-of-the-line actuators, fluid control devices and environmental control systems for the aerospace and defense industries. We strive to continuously offer new, cutting-edge products that set us apart and make us a leader in the global aerospace technology markets.

C:P3.3.text: Anhydro® designs drying, evaporation and powder processing solutions for dairy, food, pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers. The portfolio combines proven process technologies, engineering expertise and complete turnkey systems to help manufacturers improve product quality, optimize energy efficiency and maximize production performance. Supported by Innovation Center capabilities and comprehensive lifecycle support, Anhydro helps manufacturers develop, scale and optimize processes with confidence throughout the life of their plant.
